name: Vienna Insurance Group AG
summary: Vienna Insurance Group AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in providing insurance products and services in Austria and internationally. The company provides life; health; and property and casualty insurance products, such as medical expense, income protection, worker's compensation, motor vehicle liability, motor own damage, other motor, marine, aviation, transport, fire and other damage to property, general liability, credit and suretyship, legal expenses, assistance, and miscellaneous financial losses insurance. It offers reinsurance products and services, such as Issued and held Treaty reinsurance. It sells its products through direct sales, banks, brokers, and agents. The company…
